allot.subject: ESOP/ESOS/ESPS
allot.text: Samhi Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 224936  Shares against ESOPs exercised under the Company''s Employees Stock Option Plan-2023 ("ESOP-2023"), as approved by the Board of Directors of the Company. The details required under SEBI LODR Regulations & SEBI (SBEBSE) Regulations are provided for your information & records in the intimation letter enclosed.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Samhi Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about investment of funds by way of subscribing to equity shares of Ascent Hotels Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company on rights issue basis.

allot.subject: ESOP/ESOS/ESPS
allot.text: Samhi Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 1153518 Equity Shares against ESOPs exercised under the Employees Stock Option Plan - 2023 ( ESOP - 2023 ) approved through Circular Resolution dated 18th March 2025 is enclosed along with the necessary details as required under SEBI LODR Regulations & SEBI (SBEBSE) Regulations for your information and records, please.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Samhi Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about the approval of the Board of the Company in its meeting held today, i.e., 21st January 2025 for investment of the funds in its wholly-owned subsidiary, namely, Duet India Hotels (Chennai OMR) Private Limited, by way of subscribing to its equity shares on rights issue basis. A disclosure having necessary details of the transaction as required under regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations is enclosed for your kind information and records.
